title: Tunisian Yeast Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Tunisian-inspired yeast wrap, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water and yeast. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes until yeast is activated.
Add Tunisian Spice Blend and coarse salt. Mix well.
Gradually add cracked wheat, all-purpose flour, dried oregano, and dried cilantro. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal portions, depending on how large you want your wraps to be.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
Brush the tops with olive oil and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until the wraps are lightly browned and puffed.
Warm the honey in a small saucepan over low heat. Brush the tops of the wraps with the warm honey.
